## Summary

```text
A+B=D, z = algebraic zero multiplicity
max(z(A)+z(B)) = r       if k=r
                2r-1    if 0<k<r is odd
                2r      if 0<=k<r is even
```

Explicit binary matrices attain every case. At odd r>=3 and k=r-1, every maximizer has two full-length nilpotent Jordan chains. Already r=5,k=4 attains ten, while extrapolating the ordinary `2r-k` bound would give six. The excess over that expression is unbounded as support size grows.
